tools.name: get_organization_info
tools.description: Get information about a StackHawk organization

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List applications in a StackHawk organization

tools.name: validate_stackhawk_config
tools.description: Validate a StackHawk YAML configuration file

tools.name: validate_field_exists
tools.description: Validate that a field path exists in the StackHawk schema

tools.name: setup_stackhawk_for_project
tools.description: Set up StackHawk for a new project. Finds or creates the application and generates a complete stackhawk.yml configuration file ready for scanning.

host.description: Target URL to scan (e.g., https://localhost:3000, https://ginandjuice.shop)

app_name.description: Application name (optional, defaults to current directory name)

tools.name: run_stackhawk_scan
tools.description: Run a StackHawk scan using the CLI and stream results back to the chat. Optionally specify a config path (default: stackhawk.yml).

config_path.description: Path to StackHawk config file (default: stackhawk.yml)

tools.name: get_app_findings_for_triage
tools.description: Get triage-worthy findings for a project or application at or above the configured failureThreshold (or High/Medium if not set). Accepts app_id, config_path, or config_content.

config_path.description: Path to StackHawk config file (optional, default: stackhawk.yml)

config_content.description: YAML content of the StackHawk config file (optional, takes precedence over config_path)

resources.name: Current User
resources.description: Information about the authenticated user and their organizations
